name: mcp-email-verifier
description: MCP server for Email Verifier. Verify email lists on your own ZeroBounce, NeverBounce, MillionVerifier, BounceBan, or Reoon key: one flat row per address with a valid, invalid, catch all, risky, or unknown verdict plus role, free, and disposable flags. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.

apify_token.title: Apify API Token
apify_token.description: Apify API token for running the actor

email_verifier_api_key.title: Verification service API key
email_verifier_api_key.description: Your own ZeroBounce, NeverBounce, MillionVerifier, BounceBan, or Reoon key. Sent to the actor run input as a secret field, never stored by Mamba Labs.
